rubrics.justification: Mostly reasonable description of an unhatched cavitating blastocyst with intact zona and possible collapse, but it overstates confidence in AA-quality ICM/TE from this single image and does not fully reconcile the image with the reported 2AA/full blastocyst discrepancy.
Comprehensively integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, sperm quality, endometrium, lifestyle factors, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.
Logical and well-structured overall, with probability estimates and recommendations generally supported by the case details; only minor issues stem from uncertainty around day/grade interpretation.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice guidelines, including eSET, smoking/alcohol counseling, luteal support, hydrosalpinx consideration, and cautious stance on PGT-A; minor limitation is discussing a blastocyst-style Gardner grade despite a stated day-4 transfer context.

Provides clear, practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including eSET, luteal support adherence, smoking cessation, alcohol avoidance, OHSS vigilance, early pregnancy monitoring, and hydrosalpinx evaluation.
